description: This header file declares functions and includes necessary headers for handling Electronic Gasoline/Oxygen sensors (EGO sensors) within the firmware, specifically providing interfaces for retrieving AFR, checking sensor presence, setting sensor type, and initializing averaging.

methods.name: getAfr
methods.description: Returns the AFR (Air-Fuel Ratio) from the EGO sensor.

methods.name: hasAfrSensor
methods.description: Checks if an AFR sensor is present.

methods.name: setEgoSensor
methods.description: Sets the type of EGO sensor being used.

methods.name: initEgoAveraging
methods.description: Initializes averaging for EGO sensor readings.
